intent: Identify the fraudulent payment record(s) among archived payments by applying the payments/security fraud policy read-only, citing each flagged payment record path.
success_criteria: Archived payments (is_archived_basket_reference = 1) are evaluated against the documented fraud-detection policy
Exactly the fraudulent payment record(s) are identified and cited by full record_path
No files are written or deleted (read-only investigation)
Applied fraud/security policy document is cited as grounding reference

args.stdin: WITH archived AS (SELECT p.payment_id, p.record_path, p.basket_id, p.customer_id, p.store_id, p.payment_amount_cents, p.payment_currency, p.payment_status, p.payment_created_at, p.payment_method_fingerprint, p.device_fingerprint, p.observed_latitude, p.observed_longitude, p.three_ds_status, p.three_ds_failure_reason, p.three_ds_attempts, p.three_ds_max_attempts, c.home_latitude AS cust_home_lat, c.home_longitude AS cust_home_lon, c.home_city AS cust_home_city, s.latitude AS store_lat, s.longitude AS store_lon, s.city AS store_city FROM payment_transactions p JOIN customer_accounts c ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = p.store_id WHERE p.is_archived_basket_reference = :archived_flag) SELECT a.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_transactions x WHERE x.device_fingerprint = a.device_fingerprint AND x.customer_id <> a.customer_id) AS device_shared_other_customers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_transactions y WHERE y.payment_method_fingerprint = a.payment_method_fingerprint AND y.customer_id <> a.customer_id) AS method_shared_other_customers FROM archived a ORDER BY a.payment_created_at;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

answer_template.message: Fraud review: scanned archived payments (is_archived_basket_reference=1) against {policy_doc}. Flagged fraudulent payment record(s): {flagged_payment_ids} at {flagged_record_paths}. Reason: {fraud_signal}. Files unchanged (read-only).
